Territorial Boundaries. - The territorial boundaries
of Barangay Naibuan are hereby described as follows:
"Bounded on the East along Lines 1 and 2
by the Municipality of Mansalay, Province of
Oriental Mindoro;
"On the South along Lines 2, 3 and 4 by
Barangay Paclolo, Municipality of Magsaysay,
Province of Occidental Mindoro;
"On the Southwest along Lines 4 and 5 by
Barangay Murtha, Municipality of San Jose,
Province of Occidental Mindoro;
"On the Northwest along Lines 5 and 23 by
Barangay Batasan, Municipality of San Jose,
Province of Occidental Mindoro;
"On the Northwest along Lines 23, 24 and
25 by Barangay Batasan vs Barangay Monteclaro,
Municipality of San Jose, Province of Occidental
Mindoro, Case-39, CAD. 1297-D."

Conduct and Supervision of Plebiscite. - The
plebiscite conducted and supervised by the Commission on
Elections pursuant to Provincial Ordinance No. 33, Series of
2009 of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of the Province of
Occidental Mindoro, which ratified the creation of Barangay
Naibuan as proclaimed by the Plebiscite Board of Canvassers
on January 5, 2018, shall serve as substantial compliance
with the plebiscite requirement under Section 10 of Republic
Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code
of 1991", as amended.

Incumbent Barangay Officials. - The incumbent
barangay officials of Barangay Naibuan shall continue to hold
office until such time that their successors have been duly
elected and qualified.

Public Infrastructure and Facilities. - All public
infrastructure and facilities for public use existing therein at
the time of the approval of this Act shall continue to be owned
and administered by Barangay Naibuan.

National Tax Allotment (NTA) Shares. - Barangay
Naibuan shall be entitled to National Tax Allotment (NTA)
shares pursuant to Section 285 of Republic Act No. 7160,

Repealing Clause. - All laws, decrees, executive
orders, rules and regulations contrary to or inconsistent
with any provision of this Act are hereby repealed or
amended accordingly.

Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15)
days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper
of general circulation.
